message.content: I’m not able to browse the web, but I can give you a general idea based on recent market trends. In 2024, the average rent for a one‑bedroom apartment in Manhattan was around $3,200–$3,500 per month, while a two‑bedroom unit averaged $4,500–$5,000. Prices vary widely depending on the borough (Brooklyn and Queens tend to be slightly lower) and the exact neighborhood. For the most accurate and up‑to‑date figures, you could check local listings on sites like Zillow, StreetEasy, or the NYC Housing Preservation & Development website.
